verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering legal, tax and notary services, not a software product with a user interface whose functions could be mirrored by an API, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error here. The software-supported YSolutions unit and the legal-tech boilerplate describe how services are delivered, not a user-facing product. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
